sources.prompt: Use case: productivity-visual. Asset type: background illustration for a Korean presentation about a clan and its shared land and records. Primary request: a refined editorial illustration of a large Korean pine tree with visible branching roots, a small Korean tiled-roof ancestral hall and quiet hills at its foot. Style: restrained flat screenprint, bold simple silhouette forms, subtle paper grain, professional magazine illustration, no cute cartoon, no shiny 3D. Palette: warm ivory #F5F2E9 background, dark forest green #183E35, olive sage and a tiny muted terracotta accent. Composition: landscape 16:9, tree and ancestral hall in right 52% of image, left 44% almost entirely blank ivory for a large editable presentation title. Subject takes up generous area, crown at top right, broad roots across bottom right. Absolutely no lettering, no symbols that imitate a real clan crest, no logos, no borders, no watermark. This is a conceptual illustration, not a specific site.

Use case: productivity-visual. Asset type: supporting editorial illustration for a slide about AI assisting with paper records. Primary request: overhead editorial illustration of a small stack of old meeting papers, a contemporary compact audio recorder, and a smartphone with a simple abstract document screen. One tidy focal cluster, a few cream sheets with olive marks suggest writing without any readable text. Palette: warm ivory #F5F2E9 background, very dark forest green #183E35, muted olive, one terracotta accent. Style: mature minimal flat screenprint with crisp edges and subtle paper grain, no gradients, no glossy 3D, no whimsical mascots. Composition: landscape 16:9, visual object cluster on right 52% and plenty of clear blank ivory on left 44% for editable Korean text; each object recognizable at presentation scale. No letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no hands.
